XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for the Rumbos course format

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_flow
TABLE.COMMENT: Which step of a Rumbos welcome flow each user completed, and how

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the flow belongs to

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who completed the step

FIELD.NAME: mapid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Rumbos map UUID, opaque to Moodle

FIELD.NAME: stepkey
FIELD.COMMENT: The step of the flow

FIELD.NAME: revision
FIELD.COMMENT: The revision of the step that was completed

FIELD.NAME: method
FIELD.COMMENT: completed, fallback or unavailable

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the step was completed

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_result
TABLE.COMMENT: Assessment results applied from verified statements of the Rumbos service: one row per attempt

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the result belongs to

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student the result belongs to

FIELD.NAME: purpose
FIELD.COMMENT: check_in or final

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The attempt in the Rumbos service: the idempotency key

FIELD.NAME: jti
FIELD.COMMENT: The statement id: the replay guard

FIELD.NAME: payloadhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the statement's normalised claims

FIELD.NAME: percent
FIELD.COMMENT: Decimal string with two decimals, as sent

FIELD.NAME: passed
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the Rumbos service decided it is a pass

FIELD.NAME: timefinished
FIELD.COMMENT: When the attempt finished

FIELD.NAME: timeapplied
FIELD.COMMENT: When Moodle applied it

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_audit
TABLE.COMMENT: Every result statement received, accepted or rejected, with the reason

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the statement arrived

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: The HTTP status answered

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why: completed, recorded, already_applied or a rejection reason

FIELD.NAME: kid
FIELD.COMMENT: The key id of the statement header

FIELD.NAME: jti
FIELD.COMMENT: The statement id, only once its signature was verified

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The attempt, only once the signature was verified

FIELD.NAME: subject
FIELD.COMMENT: The pseudonymous user reference of the statement

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, 0 when unknown

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Moodle user once resolved, 0 otherwise

FIELD.NAME: purpose
FIELD.COMMENT: check_in or final

FIELD.NAME: percent
FIELD.COMMENT: The percent as sent

FIELD.NAME: passed
FIELD.COMMENT: The passed flag as sent

FIELD.NAME: policy
FIELD.COMMENT: The policy as sent, for example gt:80

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_mirror_def
TABLE.COMMENT: The exam definitions the Rumbos service sent for the native quiz mirror, one per form and definition hash; they hold the answer key and no user data

FIELD.NAME: formid
FIELD.COMMENT: The exam form of the Rumbos service

FIELD.NAME: hash
FIELD.COMMENT: The definition hash, which attempts name

FIELD.NAME: contentversion
FIELD.COMMENT: The version of the content pack it came from

FIELD.NAME: definition
FIELD.COMMENT: The definition object as JSON

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When it arrived

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_mirror_quiz
TABLE.COMMENT: The native Moodle quiz that mirrors one version of a Rumbos exam in a course: one row per course, form and content version

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the quiz is in

FIELD.NAME: formid
FIELD.COMMENT: The exam form of the Rumbos service

FIELD.NAME: version
FIELD.COMMENT: The content version of the form that the quiz was made from

FIELD.NAME: purpose
FIELD.COMMENT: check_in or final

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module of the quiz

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: The quiz

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the quiz was made

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_mirror_item
TABLE.COMMENT: Which question and slot of a mirror quiz holds each item of the exam

FIELD.NAME: mirrorid
FIELD.COMMENT: The mirror quiz

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: The item of the Rumbos exam

FIELD.NAME: slot
FIELD.COMMENT: The slot of the quiz

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question, at the version the quiz is pinned to

FIELD.NAME: maxmark
FIELD.COMMENT: What the item is worth in the quiz

FIELD.NAME: units
FIELD.COMMENT: The points the service gives for a full score

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_mirror_attempt
TABLE.COMMENT: The native quiz attempt written for an attempt of the Rumbos service: one row per service attempt

FIELD.NAME: mirrorid
FIELD.COMMENT: The mirror quiz

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The attempt of the Rumbos service: the idempotency key

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student

FIELD.NAME: quizattemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The quiz attempt that was written

FIELD.NAME: percent
FIELD.COMMENT: The percent the service decided

FIELD.NAME: passed
FIELD.COMMENT: What the service decided

FIELD.NAME: diverged
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the quiz total, rounded, did not equal the percent

FIELD.NAME: timefinished
FIELD.COMMENT: When the student finished

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the quiz attempt was written

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_mirror_log
TABLE.COMMENT: What the mirror refused or could not do, and the quizzes it made, for administrators; no user is recorded

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: definition or attempt

FIELD.NAME: outcome
FIELD.COMMENT: applied, rejected, failed or divergent

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: The HTTP status answered

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: The reason answered

FIELD.NAME: detail
FIELD.COMMENT: Which part was wrong, or the error

FIELD.NAME: formid
FIELD.COMMENT: The exam form, once the signature was verified

FIELD.NAME: version
FIELD.COMMENT: The content version

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The attempt of the service

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, 0 when unknown
